Extracts the AWS Lambda `cloud.resource_id` alias resolution from #20483 for independent review.

- **Resolution:** Replace an invoked alias ARN suffix with the resolved function version.
- **Compatibility:** Preserve numeric and unqualified ARNs; retain the invoked ARN when version information is unavailable.
- **Example:**
  ```text
  arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789:function:test:prod
  → arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789:function:test:42
  ```

<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT SUFFIX -->



<!-- START COPILOT ORIGINAL PROMPT -->



<details>

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> Extract the CLOUD_RESOURCE_ID behavior change from https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/20483 into a separate draft pull request against main in open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation. Do not modify PR #20483.
> 
> The user's request: "CLOUD_RESOURCE_ID ... I want to extract this change out into a separate PR because it needs more scrutiny. Send the work to the Copilot Cloud Coding Agent to implement and create that new PR."
> 
> Confirmed scope: source PR head at dispatch is 470aceb39239728df9fc494996e3dd2d81fe78b0, head branch copilot/emit-schema-url-from-instrumentations. Inspect its actual GitHub diff. Extract ONLY the AWS Lambda invocation ARN alias resolution for the cloud.resource_id attribute and directly related tests. The production change is in instrumentation/aws-lambda/aws-lambda-core-1.0/library/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/awslambdacore/v1_0/internal/AwsLambdaFunctionAttributesExtractor.java. It obtains Context.getFunctionVersion() using a cached MethodHandle and changes cloud.resource_id from the invoked ARN to the ARN qualified with the resolved function version when the invoked ARN contains an alias. Preserve numeric qualifiers, unqualified ARNs, and existing fallback behavior when version information is unavailable. The related new test is instrumentation/aws-lambda/aws-lambda-core-1.0/library/src/test/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/awslambdacore/v1_0/internal/AwsLambdaFunctionAttributesExtractorTest.java; it covers alias resolution, preserving numeric version qualifiers, preserving unqualified ARNs, and unavailable version fallback.
> 
> Implement this as an independent change from main, not stacked on #20483. Inspect supported Lambda runtime compatibility and applicable semantic conventions rather than blindly copying. Do not include scope schema URL changes, API Gateway URL_PATH/URL_SCHEME/HTTP_ROUTE additions, or their tests from #20483. Follow repository instructions, run relevant tests, and create the new draft PR with a concise accurate description, a concrete alias-to-version ARN example, and a reference to #20483. This PR is deliberately separate for scrutiny; do not broaden the change. No issue creation or replies to reviewers are requested.
> 
> A separate coordinator will monitor your new PR and remove this portion from #20483 only after your separate PR is open and contains the extracted implementation. You must leave #20483 untouched.


</details>
